retrieval_scope: SUPPORTED_FOR_PILOT links of the existing four cards only
ranking: Frozen local BGE cosine: original question plus source perspective definition against case Task; auxiliary ordering only
uncertain_application_conditions: Explain explicitly; do not discard a reference solely because a detail is not stated

evaluation.target: Useful real reference cases for the user's problem, including grounded alternative perspectives

reference_grades.2: A concrete problem-to-perspective-to-case bridge can help; state assumptions and differences
reference_grades.1: Only industry/technology/topic overlap or a bridge that requires unsupported core capabilities
reference_grades.0: No useful problem connection or explicit contradiction

evaluation.same_count_baseline: Top U single-query cases, U = distinct cases displayed across panels; duplicated memberships count once
evaluation.perspective_coverage: Apply the same independently reviewed perspective criteria to baseline cases too; labels on new results alone do not prove coverage
